title: Release 0.14.0 (quest half of the lore+quest pair; LCLI-705)
description: Quest half of the paired lore+quest v0.14.0 release (constitution Article 3). lore-cli ships LCLI-705 (Lore pane opening in teammate sessions); every release is a pair at one version, so quest ships 0.14.0 with the 55 commits on dev since 0.13.0. Follows docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md. Prep only until team-lead says otherwise: version bump PR to dev; merge, promotion, tag, staging, qualification and promotion to latest each come on the leader word, and npm publish and tag push are operator dialogs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Version strings read 0.14.0 at every site the runbook lists, and check:packages, check:lockfile and the breaking-bump pair check pass on the bump PR head
0.14.0 is staged, qualified with lore 0.14.0 by opum-cli-e2e, and promoted to latest per Article 3 clause 5
The CHANGELOG carries a dated ## 0.14.0 section and a fresh empty ## Unreleased above it at the tag

implementationNotes:
opum-ai/quest-cli#629: APPROVE at 7949d814948fd16aa971ddca8185da8aff30e90e. Reviewer opum-doc, claude-opus-5-5, by ref, stamp 2026-10-20T02:01:29Z. Record it verbatim on QCLI-499.
Measured independently, in a stripped env (env -i, PATH=/usr/bin:/bin):
- The committed npm/quest-darwin-arm64/bin/quest at the head (63,102,066 bytes, sha256 9f6583ef1358a602…, package.json 0.14.1) reports 0.14.1. In a fresh `quest init` workspace, `task list --fields id` and `task view PRB-1 --fields title` both exit 0.
- The npm 0.13.0 darwin-arm64 control exits 2 on both. A plain `task list` on 0.13.0 exits 0, which is the control's own positive control.
- LORE_SOURCE_REF bbe15535 is an ancestor of lore-cli#620's current head 984bcd81 (compare: ahead, behind 0), so it stays reachable. It's correctly marked TEMPORARY, and the CHANGELOG states 0.14.0 as tagged-never-published.
- Required contexts read green at the head, and the PR is CLEAN. The 11 re-exported schemas from lore bbe15535 are acceptable, since the later lore fix touched only setup-quest.
Land, promote origin/dev:main, and relay quest's main SHA to lore-cli. No tag, no publish.
